option_relations.rationale: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified is a broader category and does not match the specific details provided in the vignette.
The vignette describes a condition with CD8+ variant cutaneous T-cell lymphoma features, matching the leaf label for R3.2.
Mycosis fungoides (CD8-predominant variant) could be considered a subtype of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, but the specific details in the vignette more closely align with the CD8+ variant.
CD8-positive granulomatous cutaneous T-cell lymphoma might be related to cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD8+ variant, but the granulomatous aspect is not highlighted in the vignette.
